ui.they_are_under_fire_pick_the_smoke_bo.text: Ana harbinsu! Ku zaɓi Bam ɗin Hayaƙi, sannan ku taɓa mayaƙanku.

ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.en: They fight first in your next attack and take no Courtyard space.
ui.they_fight_first_in_your_next_attack_.text: Su ne ke fara yaƙi a harinku na gaba kuma ba sa ɗaukar sararin Farfajiya.

ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.en: They go home for good. You get back {arg1}% of their training cost, as far as your storage allows.
ui.they_go_home_for_good_you_get_back_of.text: Suna komawa gida har abada. Kuna samun kashi {arg1}% na kuɗin horonsu, gwargwadon yadda rumbunanku suka yarda.

ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.en: {arg1} They walk in by themselves after a raid, or when you dismiss warriors.
ui.they_walk_in_by_themselves_after_a_ra.text: {arg1} Suna shigowa da kansu bayan hari, ko idan kun sallami mayaƙa.

ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.en: They will be able to invite and to start Gang Wars. You stay in the Gang.
ui.they_will_be_able_to_invite_and_to_st.text: Za a iya gayyata da fara Yaƙe-yaƙen Gungu daga hannun sabon shugaban. Kuna nan a cikin Gungu.

ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.en: This browser can't save your village: progress is lost when this page closes. Use a normal (not private) window, or copy a save code in Settings.
ui.this_browser_can_t_save_your_village_.text: Wannan burauzar ba za ta iya adana ƙauyenku ba: ci gaba zai ɓace idan an rufe wannan shafi. Ku yi amfani da taga na yau da kullum (ba na sirri ba), ko ku kwafi lambar ajiya a Saituna.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.en: This browser may delete this village if you stay away for a while. To keep it: install Kagemura (the browser menu → Install app or Add to Home screen), link a sign-in under Online play, or copy a save code.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_this_village_.text: Wannan burauzar na iya goge wannan ƙauye idan kun daɗe ba ku zo ba. Don ajiye shi: ku saka Kagemura (menu na burauza → Install app ko Add to Home screen), ku haɗa hanyar shiga a Wasa ta intanet, ko ku kwafi lambar ajiya.

ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.en: This browser may delete your village if you stay away for a week.
ui.this_browser_may_delete_your_village_.text: Wannan burauzar na iya goge ƙauyenku idan kun yi mako ɗaya ba ku zo ba.

ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.en: This browser mode cannot save. Your village will be lost when you close the page.
ui.this_browser_mode_cannot_save_your_vi.text: Wannan yanayin burauza ba zai iya adanawa ba. Ƙauyenku zai ɓace idan kun rufe shafin.

ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.en: This device could not store your latest actions (storage full or blocked). They are being sent to the server now; free some space to keep playing offline safely.
ui.this_device_could_not_store_your_late.text: Wannan na'urar ba ta iya adana ayyukanku na baya-bayan nan ba (ajiya ta cika ko an toshe ta). Ana aika su sabar yanzu; ku samar da sarari don ci gaba da wasa ba tare da intanet ba lafiya.

ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.en: This device still holds your online account on
ui.this_device_still_holds_your_online_a.text: Wannan na'urar har yanzu tana riƙe da asusunku na intanet a

ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.en: This device will play the account linked to that sign-in. If its village is kept on the server, it replaces the village here, which stays as a backup in Settings. Your current online account is not deleted.
ui.this_device_will_play_the_account_lin.text: Wannan na'urar za ta buga asusun da aka haɗa da wannan hanyar shiga. Idan ana adana ƙauyensa a sabar, zai maye gurbin ƙauyen nan, wanda zai zauna a matsayin kwafi a Saituna. Ba a goge asusunku na intanet na yanzu ba.

ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.en: This is a {arg1} server for testing: villages and purchases here are separate from the real game.
ui.this_is_a_server_for_testing_villages.text: Wannan sabar {arg1} ce ta gwaji: ƙauyuka da sayayya a nan dabam suke da na ainihin wasan.

ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.en: This is the testing sandbox: a separate practice village with online play off. Skipping time moves the sandbox clock ahead for good; your real village is never affected.
ui.this_is_the_testing_sandbox_a_separat.text: Wannan shi ne filin gwaji: ƙauyen atisaye dabam da wasa ta intanet a kashe. Tsallake lokaci yana gabatar da agogon filin gwaji har abada; ƙauyenku na gaske ba ya taɓa shafuwa.

ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.en: This starts a new village that is kept on the server. The village on this device stays as a backup you can restore in Settings.
ui.this_starts_a_new_village_that_is_kep.text: Wannan yana fara sabon ƙauye da ake adanawa a sabar. Ƙauyen da ke wannan na'urar zai zauna a matsayin kwafi da za ku iya dawo da shi a Saituna.

ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.en: Time skips and test purchases live in a separate testing sandbox, so they can never change your real village or online play.
ui.time_skips_and_test_purchases_live_in.text: Tsallake lokaci da sayayyar gwaji suna cikin filin gwaji dabam, don kada su taɓa canza ƙauyenku na gaske ko wasa ta intanet.

ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.en: Time until everyone who fits in the Squad Courtyards has finished
ui.time_until_everyone_who_fits_in_the_s.text: Lokaci har sai duk wanda ya shiga Farfajiyoyin Tawaga ya gama

ui.train_some_warriors_first_38d2ad4cb0.text: Ku fara horar da wasu mayaƙa.

ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.en: Train some warriors first: duels use your army (none are spent).
ui.train_some_warriors_first_duels_use_y.text: Ku fara horar da wasu mayaƙa: fafatawa tana amfani da rundunarku (ba a kashe kowa).

ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.en: Train some warriors, then save the mix here to refill it later.
ui.train_some_warriors_then_save_the_mix.text: Ku horar da wasu mayaƙa, sannan ku adana haɗin a nan don sake cika shi daga baya.

ui.train_warriors_to_donate_bbdc43a025.text: Ku horar da mayaƙa don bayarwa.

ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.en: Trained ahead. They join your army when the Squad Courtyards have room. Jade can't finish them until then.
ui.trained_ahead_they_join_your_army_whe.text: An horar tun da wuri. Za su shiga rundunarku idan Farfajiyoyin Tawaga suna da sarari. Jed ba zai iya gama su ba sai lokacin.

ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.en: Training opens as soon as the work is done.
ui.training_opens_as_soon_as_the_work_is.text: Horo yana buɗewa da zarar an gama aikin.

ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.en: Two to four friends against another Gang of the same size: 2 hours to prepare, then 22 hours with 2 attacks each. Strike alone, or relay: a relay strike starts from half the damage of your Gang’s last strike on that base (defenders patch up in between). No honor is won or lost; everyone gets a chest.
ui.two_to_four_friends_against_another_g.text: Abokai biyu zuwa huɗu da wani Gungu mai girma iri ɗaya: awa 2 don shiri, sannan awa 22 da hare-hare 2 kowanne. Ku kai bugu ku kaɗai, ko bi-da-bi: bugun bi-da-bi yana farawa daga rabin ɓarnar bugun ƙarshe na Gungunku a kan wannan sansani (masu tsaro suna gyarawa a tsakani). Babu daraja da ake ci ko a rasa; kowa yana samun akwati.

ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.en: Until the season ends: {pct}% faster builds, the {arg1} look and bigger rewards on every tier. Rewards you already earned unlock right away.
ui.until_the_season_ends_20_faster_build.text: Har ƙarshen kaka: gini mai sauri kashi {pct}%, kamannin {arg1} da manyan lada a kowane mataki. Ladan da kuka riga kuka samu suna buɗewa nan take.

ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.en: Update Kagemura from {arg1}, then open it again.
ui.update_kagemura_from_then_open_it_aga.text: Ku sabunta Kagemura daga {arg1}, sannan ku sake buɗe shi.

ui.upgrading_your_clan_keep_to_level_unl.en: Upgrading your Clan Keep to level {arg1} unlocks:

ui.use_the_built_in_setting_fa2e4b675f.text: Yi amfani da saitin da ke ciki

ui.vibration_on_phones_that_support_it_3.text: Girgiza (a wayoyin da ke goyon bayansa)

ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.en: Village map. Drag to look around, pinch or scroll to zoom, tap a building to select it. Every action is also on the buttons around the map.
ui.village_map_drag_to_look_around_pinch.text: Taswirar ƙauye. Ku ja don duba kewaye, ku matse ko ku gungura don zuƙowa, ku taɓa gini don zaɓar shi. Kowane aiki yana kan maɓallan da ke kewayen taswira ma.

ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.en: Warriors need two buildings: the Dojo trains them and the Courtyard houses them.
ui.warriors_need_two_buildings_the_dojo_.text: Mayaƙa na buƙatar gine-gine biyu: Dojo yana horar da su kuma Farfajiya tana ɗaukar su.

ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.en: We keep only an age group on this device and our server, never your date of birth. Please answer honestly: our support team can correct a mistake.
ui.we_keep_only_an_age_group_on_this_dev.text: Muna ajiye rukunin shekaru kaɗai a wannan na'urar da sabarmu, ba ranar haihuwarku ba. Don Allah ku amsa da gaskiya: ƙungiyar taimakonmu za ta iya gyara kuskure.

ui.what_keep_lv_unlocks_ced96de6b4.text: Abin da Fada mataki {arg1} ke buɗewa

ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.en: When the game hits an error, it sends the error message, where in the code it happened, the game version and the platform, to help fix it. It does not add your name, Player ID, village or chat, but an error message can sometimes include text the game was working on.
ui.when_the_game_hits_an_error_it_sends_.text: Idan wasan ya gamu da kuskure, yana aika saƙon kuskuren, inda a cikin lambar ya faru, sigar wasan da dandalin, don taimakawa a gyara shi. Ba ya ƙara sunanku, Lambar Ɗan Wasa, ƙauye ko hira, amma saƙon kuskure wani lokaci zai iya ƙunsar rubutun da wasan ke aiki a kai.

ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.en: When the last of this stack finishes, after everyone ahead of it
ui.when_the_last_of_this_stack_finishes_.text: Idan na ƙarshe na wannan tari ya gama, bayan duk waɗanda ke gabansa

ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.en: Where you live, Google Play confirms ages for apps. Open the Play Store app, verify your age there, then come back: online play and purchases unlock once Google Play shares your age group.
ui.where_you_live_google_play_confirms_a.text: A inda kuke zaune, Google Play ne ke tabbatar da shekaru ga manhajoji. Ku buɗe manhajar Play Store, ku tabbatar da shekarunku a can, sannan ku dawo: wasa ta intanet da sayayya suna buɗewa da zarar Google Play ya raba rukunin shekarunku.

ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.en: Where you live, the App Store confirms ages for apps. Confirm your age in your Apple Account settings, then come back.
ui.where_you_live_the_app_store_confirms.text: A inda kuke zaune, App Store ne ke tabbatar da shekaru ga manhajoji. Ku tabbatar da shekarunku a saitunan Apple Account ɗinku, sannan ku dawo.

ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.en: Win raids to earn honor; lose it when your attacks fail or when raiders beat your village. More honor bring tougher opponents with more loot.
ui.win_raids_to_earn_honor_lose_it_when_.text: Ku ci hare-hare don samun daraja; za ku rasa ta idan harinku ya kasa ko idan mahara sun ci ƙauyenku. Daraja mafi yawa tana kawo abokan hamayya masu ƙarfi da ganima mai yawa.

ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.en: You are about to spend {arg1} of real money. Make sure a parent or guardian says it's OK.
ui.you_are_about_to_spend_of_real_money_.text: Kuna gab da kashe {arg1} na kuɗi na gaske. Ku tabbata iyaye ko mai kula sun amince.

ui.you_are_in_the_top_league_8b390ac669.en: You are in the top league!

ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.en: You are playing on your own: opponents, raiders and your Alliance are friendly bots (always labelled as computer players). To raid real players and join real Alliances, enter a Kagemura: Ninja Clans server address under Advanced, below.
ui.you_are_playing_on_your_own_opponents.text: Kuna wasa ku kaɗai: abokan hamayya, mahara da Ƙawancenku na kwamfuta ne masu abota (kullum ana yi musu alama a matsayin ƴan wasan kwamfuta). Don kai wa ƴan wasa na gaske hari da shiga Ƙawance na gaske, ku shigar da adireshin sabar Kagemura: Dangin Ninja a Na gaba-gaba, a ƙasa.

ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.en: You can add each other again later.
ui.you_can_add_each_other_again_later_01.text: Kuna iya sake ƙara juna daga baya.

ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.en: You can found or join a Gang again after 24 hours.
ui.you_can_found_or_join_a_gang_again_af.text: Kuna iya sake kafa ko shiga Gungu bayan awa 24.

ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.en: You can join another Alliance straight away. Warriors in your Alliance Lodge stay with you.
ui.you_can_join_another_alliance_straigh.text: Kuna iya shiga wani Ƙawance nan take. Mayaƙan da ke Zauren Ƙawancenku suna tare da ku.

ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.en: You can keep {arg1} saved armies. Delete one to save this army.
ui.you_can_keep_saved_armies_delete_one_.text: Kuna iya ajiye runduna {arg1} da aka adana. Ku goge ɗaya don adana wannan runduna.

ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.en: You finished the training. Please enter your year of birth: it sets the right protections for your age (spending limits, offers, and for online play who can find you and how you chat).
ui.you_finished_the_training_please_ente.text: Kun gama koyarwa. Don Allah ku shigar da shekarar haihuwarku: tana saita kariyar da ta dace da shekarunku (iyakokin kashe kuɗi, tayi, kuma ga wasa ta intanet: wa zai iya gano ku da yadda kuke hira).

ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.en: You have not cleared a tier yet.
ui.you_have_not_cleared_a_tier_yet_cb231.text: Ba ku wuce wani mataki ba tukuna.

ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.en: You have the premium Season Scroll this season.
ui.you_have_the_premium_season_scroll_th.text: Kuna da Takardar Kaka ta musamman a wannan kaka.

ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.en: You joined after this war started: cheer your Gang on.
ui.you_joined_after_this_war_started_che.text: Kun shiga bayan wannan yaƙi ya fara: ku ƙarfafa Gungunku.

ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.en: You left a Gang lately: you can found or join one in {arg1}.
ui.you_left_a_gang_lately_you_can_found_.text: Kun bar wani Gungu kwanan nan: za ku iya kafa ko shiga ɗaya cikin {arg1}.

ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.en: You'll get back {arg1}% of what you paid.
ui.you_ll_get_back_of_what_you_paid_5919.text: Za ku sami kashi {arg1}% na abin da kuka biya.

ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.en: You stop being friends, and neither of you can find or ask the other.
ui.you_stop_being_friends_and_neither_of.text: Abotarku za ta ƙare, kuma babu ɗayanku da zai iya nemo ko tambayar ɗayan.

ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.en: Your age group can only be made stricter here. To correct it, contact support from Settings → Privacy and help.
ui.your_age_group_can_only_be_made_stric.text: Za a iya ƙara tsananta rukunin shekarunku a nan kaɗai. Don gyara shi, ku tuntuɓi taimako daga Saituna → Sirri da taimako.

ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.en: Your Alliance is matched with a real Alliance of similar size and strength, or with a band of wild bots when none is free. Only members who were in the Alliance when the raid starts take part.
ui.your_alliance_is_matched_with_a_real_.text: Ana haɗa Ƙawancenku da Ƙawance na gaske mai girma da ƙarfi kusan iri ɗaya, ko da gungun na kwamfuta na daji idan babu wanda ke da sarari. Mambobin da ke cikin Ƙawance lokacin da harin ya fara ne kaɗai ke shiga.

ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.en: Your Clan Keep is at the highest level available right now.
ui.your_clan_keep_is_at_the_highest_leve.text: Fadar Danginku tana mataki mafi girma da ake da shi yanzu.

ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.en: Your current layout is now your duel layout.
ui.your_current_layout_is_now_your_duel_.text: Tsarinku na yanzu shi ne tsarin fafatawarku yanzu.

ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.en: Your current village on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_current_village_on_this_device_w.text: Za a goge ƙauyenku na yanzu a wannan na'urar. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.

ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.en: Your earlier village is back. The one you were playing is kept in Settings.
ui.your_earlier_village_is_back_the_one_.text: Ƙauyenku na baya ya dawo. Wanda kuke wasa da shi an ajiye shi a Saituna.

ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack! when you are ready.
ui.your_first_raid_tap_attack_when_you_a.text: Harinku na farko. Ku taɓa Kai hari! idan kun shirya.

ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.en: Your friend code always works: share it only with people you want to add.
ui.your_friend_code_always_works_share_i.text: Lambar abotarku tana aiki kullum: ku raba ta da mutanen da kuke son ƙarawa kawai.

ui.your_leader_starts_gang_wars_fe4ca360.text: Shugabanku ne ke fara Yaƙe-yaƙen Gungu.

ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your new village is kept on the server.
ui.your_new_village_is_kept_on_the_serve.text: Ana adana sabon ƙauyenku a sabar.

ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.en: Your {arg1} on {arg2} was interrupted and has been played out: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. See the battle log.
ui.your_on_was_interrupted_and_has_been_.text: {arg1} ɗinku kan {arg2} ya katse kuma an kammala shi: {arg3}★, {arg4}%. Ku duba tarihin yaƙi.

ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.en: Your online account was deleted. Restarting offline…
ui.your_online_account_was_deleted_resta.text: An goge asusunku na intanet. Ana sake farawa ba tare da intanet ba…

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance membership, chat messages and warrior requests are deleted from the server now. Online attacks still waiting for the server become practice results. Online play turns off on this device; your village stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Ana goge sunan ɗan wasanku, sansanin da aka raba, zama membanku a Ƙawance, saƙonnin hira da buƙatun mayaƙa daga sabar yanzu. Hare-haren intanet da ke jiran sabar za su zama sakamakon atisaye. Wasa ta intanet yana kashewa a wannan na'urar; ƙauyenku yana nan. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.

ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.en: Your player name, shared base, Alliance and Gang membership, friends, chat messages and any village kept on {arg1} are deleted from that server now. Online play stays off; your village on this device stays. This cannot be undone.
ui.your_player_name_shared_base_alliance.text: Ana goge sunan ɗan wasanku, sansanin da aka raba, zama membanku a Ƙawance da Gungu, abokai, saƙonnin hira da duk ƙauyen da aka adana a {arg1} daga wannan sabar yanzu. Wasa ta intanet yana nan a kashe; ƙauyenku a wannan na'urar yana nan. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.

ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.en: Your purchase is here, but this device could not save it (storage full?). Free some space: it stays open in the store and is delivered again if needed.
ui.your_purchase_is_here_but_this_device.text: Sayayyarku ta iso, amma wannan na'urar ba ta iya adana ta ba (ajiya ta cika?). Ku samar da sarari: tana nan a buɗe a shagon kuma za a sake isar da ita idan an buƙata.

ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.en: Your remaining warriors go back home. You keep any loot you already won.
ui.your_remaining_troops_go_back_home_yo.text: Sauran mayaƙanku suna komawa gida. Kuna riƙe duk ganimar da kuka riga kuka ci.

ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.en: Your stars count toward the Alliance War.
ui.your_stars_count_toward_the_alliance_.text: Taurarinku suna ƙirguwa a Yaƙin Ƙawance.

ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.en: Your Training Dojo trains {arg1}× faster than a level 1 Dojo.
ui.your_training_dojo_trains_faster_than.text: Dojon Horonku yana horarwa da sauri {arg1}× fiye da Dojo mataki 1.

ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.en: Your village could not be saved ({arg1}). Free some device storage, and copy a save code in Settings to keep it safe.
ui.your_village_could_not_be_saved_free_.text: Ba a iya adana ƙauyenku ba ({arg1}). Ku samar da sarari a na'urarku, kuma ku kwafi lambar ajiya a Saituna don kiyaye shi.

ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.en: Your village is kept on the server: every change to its resources, buildings, army and research is checked there, so it cannot be lost with this device. What you do is sent as you play; while offline it waits and goes when you reconnect.
ui.your_village_is_kept_on_the_server_ev.text: Ana adana ƙauyenku a sabar: ana duba kowane canji ga albarkatunsa, gine-gine, runduna da bincike a can, don kada ya ɓace tare da wannan na'urar. Ana aika abin da kuke yi yayin da kuke wasa; idan ba intanet yana jira ya tafi idan kun sake haɗawa.

ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.en: Your village is now kept on the server.
ui.your_village_is_now_kept_on_the_serve.text: Yanzu ana adana ƙauyenku a sabar.

ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.en: Your village is on the server now. {arg1} could not be matched to a purchase we checked, so it is held for review: contact support from Settings. Your old village is kept as a backup.
ui.your_village_is_on_the_server_now_cou.text: Ƙauyenku yana kan sabar yanzu. Ba a iya daidaita {arg1} da sayayyar da muka duba ba, don haka an riƙe shi don bita: ku tuntuɓi taimako daga Saituna. An ajiye tsohon ƙauyenku a matsayin kwafi.

ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.en: Your village is saved, and your Artisans keep working while you are away.
ui.your_village_is_saved_and_your_artisa.text: An adana ƙauyenku, kuma Maginanku suna ci gaba da aiki yayin da ba ku nan.

ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.en: Your village moves to the server as it is, if it is a village its Keep could really have. From then on every change is checked there, and you can play it on other devices by linking a sign-in.
ui.your_village_moves_to_the_server_as_i.text: Ƙauyenku yana komawa sabar yadda yake, idan ƙauye ne da Fadarsa za ta iya samu a zahiri. Daga nan ana duba kowane canji a can, kuma kuna iya buga shi a wasu na'urori ta hanyar haɗa hanyar shiga.

ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.en: Your village saves automatically on this device. To move it to another device, copy a save code here and load it there.
ui.your_village_saves_automatically_on_t.text: Ƙauyenku yana adanuwa kai tsaye a wannan na'urar. Don mayar da shi wata na'ura, ku kwafi lambar ajiya a nan ku loda ta a can.

ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.en: Your village was opened in another tab or window, and only one can save it. Your progress is safe there.
ui.your_village_was_opened_in_another_ta.text: An buɗe ƙauyenku a wani shafi ko taga, kuma ɗaya kaɗai ne zai iya adana shi. Ci gabanku yana lafiya a can.

ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.en: Your village was saved by a newer version of Kagemura, so this version cannot open it. It is safe and unchanged.
ui.your_village_was_saved_by_a_newer_ver.text: Sabuwar sigar Kagemura ce ta adana ƙauyenku, don haka wannan sigar ba za ta iya buɗe shi ba. Yana lafiya kuma bai canza ba.

ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.en: Your war base now matches your village.
ui.your_war_base_now_matches_your_villag.text: Sansanin yaƙinku ya yi daidai da ƙauyenku yanzu.
